profile.headline: MTS @ Subquadratic
profile.summary: I love to create solutions to problems via code. I believe in both scrappiness and meticulousness.

positions.title: Full-Stack Web Engineer
positions.description:
-Contracted by an industry-leading tech innovator to enhance web platform functionality using React, Django, OpenAI APIs, Claude, Psycopg2, Beautifulsoup, Pinecone, Node.JS, other libraries
-Frequently converted detailed Figma designs into responsive React-based user interfaces, optimizing for both mobile and desktop within tight deadlines
-Heavily integrating AI capabilities into established platforms, such as MyFitnessPal, Sokolin, enhancing core offerings and delivering next-level experiences to users
-Continuously developed front-end interfaces with rapid turnarounds
-Thrived in fast-paced environments, while maintaining technical expertise and composure

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description: Built pilot-facing webapp prototype to optimize in-flight retrieval of crucial flight data
